definition: The browser API for building immersive VR and AR experiences.
A fully synthetic stereo scene that replaces the user's view ('immersive-vr').
Virtual content composited over the real world via passthrough or see-through optics ('immersive-ar').
A non-immersive XR session rendered inside a normal page element.
A coordinate system XRFrame poses are reported in (local, local-floor, bounded-floor, unbounded, viewer).
A reference space whose origin sits on the floor beneath the user.
A floor-level space bounded by a polygon the user defined (their play area).
